A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CoMa research and contain 12 readable pages. Text, equations, figures, tables, and appendix material, including Figure 6 and Table 4, support comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original CoMa benchmark results, pretraining ablations, and representation analyses in Tables 2–4 and Figures 2–5.

after.justification: v3 retains these original benchmark results, ablations, and representation analyses, including the detailed appendix results.

M1.justification: The compression-token architecture, attention mask, QA pretraining, mean pooling, and subsequent contrastive learning remain unchanged. The revised objective expression aligns the formal description with the already documented masking procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same pretraining image sources and 36 MMEB-V1 datasets across classification, VQA, retrieval, and grounding. Replacing some mentions of MMEB with MMEB-V1 clarifies existing coverage.

E2.justification: Tables 2 and 4 retain their respective comparator sets, including VLM2Vec, UniME, mmE5, and MoCa. No evaluated baseline is added or removed.

E3.justification: Section 6.2 revises the reported ablation setup: v2 separately lists split multi-turn dialogues and single-turn data, whereas v3 describes one single-turn variant. This changes the stated design without establishing reruns. Main splits, metrics, model sizes, and training settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Section 6.2 drops the separately stated split-dialogue comparison. All tabulated ablations and token-scaling, similarity, PCA, and loss-distribution analyses remain. Description and Caption rows already existed in v2, so their expanded explanation introduces no new ablation.

E5.justification: Both versions retain point-estimate reporting without repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The 100-instance sampling description for token similarity is unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical tables and plotted results match; CoMa's Table 2 overall scores remain 67.5 and 72.2 for 3B and 7B. The limited change is deletion of the explicit qualitative finding that multi-turn dialogues outperform separately split dialogues, which lacked a separately identified Table 3 row.

T1.justification: Section 3.2.2 changes P(A | I ⊕ C(X) ⊕ Q; θ) to P(A | C ⊕ Question; θ), removing direct image conditioning from the formal objective. This corrects the stated dependency to match the existing compression bottleneck; no theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The central contributions remain compression pretraining followed by contrastive learning, automated QA synthesis, and competitive or state-of-the-art embeddings with limited training resources. The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain these claims.

C2.justification: Section 6.4 changes the explanation for KL's weaker performance from excessive reconstruction training to restricted generalization, and reframes the method around latent compression-token optimization. Section 6.2 recommends captions instead of descriptions as the efficient large-data alternative. The resource limitation is unchanged.

D1.justification: v3 adds a project repository URL in the abstract. Existing implementation settings, data-generation instructions, and the appendix prompt remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive positioning relative to earlier embedding and pretraining approaches remain unchanged. Edits to the GME discussion preserve its meaning.

P1.justification: The title changes from 'Compression then Matching' to 'Compressing then Matching'. v3 makes localized language and terminology edits, rewrites portions of Sections 6.2 and 6.4, and adds acknowledgments and project-leader attribution. The overall section organization remains intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1's caption is streamlined and stray punctuation removed. Affiliation formatting and text reflow shift some figure and table placement. Figure artwork and table structures remain unchanged; the two appendix pages are visually identical.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves clarity by aligning the objective with the documented attention mask and making the ablation narrative more consistent with Table 3. The project URL improves access guidance. These are limited gains: empirical evidence is unchanged, and the revised generalization explanation remains interpretive.
